It absolutely does. To show why, I will compare MiMo V2.5 with DeepSeek V4 Flash (the preview). Same price per token, almost the same model size, same release day.

AA Intelligence Index: 40 vs 37
Tokens Per Second: 112 vs 68
Thus far DeepSeek wins. But the kicker is this:
Total output tokens: 234M vs 71M

Time per task, minutes: 5.5 vs 4.

Half the tps, yet still faster. But most importantly, since price is just output tokens times price:
Price to run AA II: $74 vs $25!

So MiMo, despite being the same price and much slower per token, is both faster per task and only a third (!!) of the total cost.

To clarify, 0731 does not fix this. 12% fewer tokens got the price from $74 to $72. That came out of the model getting smarter with better behaviors, not a true efficiency pass. MiMo showed two months ago that a third of the output tokens is possible.
